proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro G _ _ _ d hd
  haveI : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
  have hn : 0 < Nat.card G := Nat.card_pos
  have hd0 : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd hn
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := IsCyclic.exists_ofOrder_eq_natCard (α := G)
  have hq : Nat.card G / d ∣ orderOf g := by
    rw [hg]
    exact Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd hd
  have hq0 : Nat.card G / d ≠ 0 := (Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hn hd) hd0).ne'
  have hcard : ∀ H : Subgroup G, Nat.card H = d → (H : Set G) = {a : G | a ^ d = 1} := by
    intro H hH
    have hsub : (H : Set G) ⊆ {a : G | a ^ d = 1} := by
      intro x hx
      have hx' : (⟨x, hx⟩ : H) ^ Nat.card H = 1 := pow_card_eq_one'
      rw [hH] at hx'
      simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hx'
    have hle : (Finset.univ.filter fun a : G => a ^ d = 1).card ≤ d := IsCyclic.card_pow_eq_one_le hd0
    have hset : {a : G | a ^ d = 1} = ↑(Finset.univ.filter fun a : G => a ^ d = 1) := by
      ext a
      simp
    have hHcard : (H : Set G).ncard = d := by
      rw [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
      exact hH
    apply Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le hsub
    rw [hHcard, hset, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
    exact hle
  refine ⟨Subgroup.zpowers (g ^ (Nat.card G / d)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Nat.card (Subgroup.zpowers (g ^ (Nat.card G / d))) = d
    rw [Nat.card_zpowers, orderOf_pow_of_dvd hq0 hq, hg]
    exact Nat.div_div_self hd hn.ne'
  · intro K hK
    have h1 := hcard K hK
    have h2 : Nat.card (Subgroup.zpowers (g ^ (Nat.card G / d))) = d := by
      rw [Nat.card_zpowers, orderOf_pow_of_dvd hq0 hq, hg]
      exact Nat.div_div_self hd hn.ne'
    have h3 := hcard _ h2
    exact SetLike.coe_injective (h1.trans h3.symm)
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] [IsCyclic G] (d : ℕ), d ∣ Nat.card G → ∃! H : Subgroup G, Nat.card H = d
